name: Trauma Shears and LED Penlight Set (3 Pack)
seoTitle: Nurse Penlight and Trauma Shears Gift Set
metaDescription: A budget friendly set of 8 inch trauma shears and two LED penlights with a pupil gauge, an easy stocking stuffer for ER nurses, EMTs, and students.
summary: One pair of 8 inch trauma shears plus two LED penlights with pupil gauges, a small and useful bundle for the scrub pocket.
whyItWorks: Penlights and shears are the socks of nursing gifts: never glamorous, always needed. Penlights roll under beds, get pocketed by residents, and die in the middle of an assessment, while shears disappear the moment they are set down. A set with one pair of shears and two penlights gives a nurse a backup on hand instead of borrowing from whoever is at the next computer.

The pupil gauge printed on the penlights is a nice touch for nursing students learning neuro checks, since it puts a handy reference right on the tool. At 8 inches, the shears are a full size pair for everyday unit tasks like cutting tape. Because the set is budget friendly, it works well for a whole cohort of classmates, a Secret Santa limit, or a basket of goodies for the unit during Nurses Week. Add a handwritten card and it feels personal.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see whether batteries are included for the penlights.
Penlights get shared and lost often, so this set works nicely as a spare stash for a work bag.
Buying several sets is an easy way to cover a whole clinical group.

faq.q: Can nursing students use these in clinicals?
faq.a: Yes. Penlights and shears are standard items students carry, and the pupil gauge is handy while learning assessments.

faq.q: Is this enough for a full gift?
faq.a: On its own it is a small gift, great for stockings or exchanges. Pair it with a badge reel or a mug for something bigger.
